content:
Within the FoC – Future of Construction project, a practical session was held on 12 October with a view to the preparation of the “Agenda for Carbon Neutrality and Circular Economy of the AEC Sector”. The event took place at LNEC and was co-organized by 3drivers and BUILT CoLAB.

This Workshop, intended for professionals and researchers in the field of sustainability, aimed to prepare the referred Agenda, having been developed in a Design Thinking approach to stimulate discussion on the future of the sector. To this end, and to achieve concrete results, four exercises were prepared, whose dynamics led the 30 or so participants to reflect on the theme based on their opinion and experience.

This session is, therefore, a consultation with stakeholders in the sector, and its results will be the basis for the vision and action plan of the Agenda for Carbon Neutrality and Circular Economy of the AEC Sector, one of the activities of the FoC – Future of Construction project of the responsibility of BUILT CoLAB, and which is being developed in collaboration with the consultancy 3drivers – Engineering, Innovation and Environment.
